one_liner: Cloud spreadsheet-database hybrid for building apps and workflows on structured data.

auth.evidence_quote: OAuth access tokens are recommended for building an integration where other users grant your service access to Airtable's API on their behalf.
auth.notes: Legacy API keys were deprecated Feb 1 2024; personal access tokens (bearer, not called 'API key' by vendor post-deprecation) remain for single-account use.

access.evidence_quote: Personal access tokens are for personal development, like building an integration for yourself, your client, or your company.
access.notes: Airtable has a free plan with API access; no explicit app-review gate documented on this page for OAuth apps.

api.evidence_quote: must be authenticated and made through HTTPS
api.notes: Endpoint count and MCP status not directly confirmed within the 4-call budget.

verdict.rationale: Free-tier account with documented OAuth2 flow and no confirmed production gate beyond standard OAuth consent.
